title: Joel And Kerri — EN/SN/ZU (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar Shona Zulu language learning warm baritone storytelling 104bpm Zimbabwe family portrait trilingual celebration
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two worlds, one road
A farm in Zimbabwe, a life yet to be told
Her father walked the rows at sunrise
Her mother ran the dairy cold

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Misha miviri, nzira imwe (Two homes, one road)
Purazi reZimbabwe, hupenyu husati hwatariswa (A farm in Zimbabwe, a life yet to be seen)
Baba wake vakafamba nemashambanzou (Her father walked at sunrise)
Amai vake vakashanda zvakasimba (Her mother worked with great strength)

[Chorus - Zulu, with English translations]
UJoel noKerri (Joel and Kerri)
Uthuli olubomvu nemvula yaseningizimu (Red dust and southern rain)
UJoel noKerri (Joel and Kerri)
Imihlaba emibili negama elilodwa (Two homelands in one name)
I-mbira icula, imithi yeqhawe iphendula (The mbira plays and the gum trees answer)
KuseHarare kuze kufinyelele ekukhanyeni kweharbour (From Harare to the harbour light)
UJoel noKerri (Joel and Kerri)

[Bridge - all three languages]
English: The farm is still there in the stories
Shona: Purazi riri ipapo munyaya (The farm is still there in the stories)
Zulu: Ifamu iseyikhona ezindabeni (The farm is still there in the stories)

[Outro - all three]
English: Joel and Kerri — yes
Shona: Joel naKerri — hongu (Joel and Kerri — yes)
Zulu: UJoel noKerri — yebo (Joel and Kerri — yes)
